Slatebridge has rolled out Auto-Rebalance, our latest feature that automates job reassignment when a technician calls out sick. This saves dispatchers 45 minutes of re-planning per incident—imagine freeing up time to focus on high-priority issues instead of endless phone calls.

We've made this new tool available today for all customers at no extra cost. As an operations manager, you know how these last-minute changes can disrupt your day. Try Auto-Rebalance and see the difference it makes in your workflow.
